title: Replication package: Promise versus Delivery — The Fiscal Anchoring of Argentina's Disinflation under Milei, 2023-2026
description:
Replication repository for the working paper Promise versus Delivery: The Fiscal Anchoring of Argentina's Disinflation under Milei, 2023-2026. Python ingests and cleans; R analyses; outputs are Chart.js widgets, static PNG figures and regression tables.

Data vintage locked 2026-06-13 at the May 2026 CPI print (vintage_end: 2026-05-31 in config/params.yaml). No observation after that date enters the panels, and the ingest scripts refuse to run while the vintage is locked. Every raw download is timestamped under data-raw/{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/ and never overwritten; all published estimates are recomputed on this locked panel only. Raw downloads are not redistributed here — make ingest reconstructs them from the sources listed in config/urls.yaml.
